{{nihongo|'''Akaba Shrine'''|赤羽神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in Ikawadani-chō, {{ill|Nishi-ku, Kobe|Q1154552|qid=Q1154552|lt=Nishi Ward}}, {{ill|Kobe|Q48320|qid=Q48320}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|Q130290|qid=Q130290}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine ranking}} it was classified as a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. {{nihongo|'''Akaba Shrine'''|赤羽神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Harima Province]].

* {{ill|Tamanooya-no-Mikoto|Q11572729|qid=Q11572729|lt=Ame no Hakarutama no Kami}} (Ame no Hakarutama no Kami)

* {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602|lt=Ōhirume Muchi no Mikoto}} (Ōhirume Muchi no Mikoto)

== History ==
The name “Akaba” is said to derive from the “Hane-akadama” (Red Feather Jewel) that {{ill|Amenohiboko|Q713100|qid=Q713100|lt=Ame no Hiboko}} brought to Japan during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Suinin|Q314850|qid=Q314850}}<ref name="Akaba Travelogue">[http://nature1818.jp/kobe/ Akaba, Junna, Ikawadani-chō, Nishi Ward, Kobe City, Hyōgo Prefecture | Akaba Travelogue] Accessed February 1, 2019</ref>.

In the {{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}} {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Register of Deities}}, compiled in {{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274|lt=Enchō}} 5 ({{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}), it is listed as “Akaba Shrine” in {{ill|Harima Province|Q1047523|qid=Q1047523}} {{ill|Akashi District, Hyōgo|Q11512561|qid=Q11512561}}, and is included among the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.

The {{ill|Dai Nippon Chimei Jisho|Q17213149|qid=Q17213149}} contains the description, “The Engishiki Akaba Shrine is located in Akaba (Akaha) of Izawa-no-shō, Izumi Village,” suggesting that the name once remained as a place name as well<ref name="Akaba Travelogue" />.
